measured: 2026-10-28, Claude desktop app browser pane, WebGL2 on ANGLE Metal, Apple M1; scene with the stage-two research device and gantry arches; overview camera, tick 120, playing; 240 frames after an 8 s warm-up

balanced.note: vsync-limited at 60 fps: the true headroom is not measured; draw calls rose from 86 to 95 and instances from 42684 to 44130 against the stage-one scene (arches, device layer)

high: not measured: the browser pane was hidden when the run was attempted, so requestAnimationFrame was throttled and no frames were drawn (frames = 0). Instance count of the high tier: 67785 instances, 145618 edge segments (static count only).
headless_captures: the screenshots in docs/ecosystem/visual were taken in headless Chromium on SwiftShader (software); frame rates there (0.1-1.3 fps) are software rendering and are not a performance measure
performance_target: no explicit target was set; 60 fps (the display limit) was reached at the balanced tier on this one machine
